### Summary
SPEC-LANGUAGE §3.1 N5 / T8 and N3 guarantee that map zero values auto-allocate empty maps so that first writes succeed where Go panics on a nil map. Previously, zero map allocation was limited to declaration sites (`var` locals, unkeyed struct fields, `new(T)`), leaving `make([]T, n)` slice elements and `[N]T` array elements as Go nil maps.

### Changes
1. **Lower `make([]T, n[, c])`**:
   - Added generic prelude helper `hy_n5_make[t any](init func() t, n int, cap ...int) []t` to `compiler/crates/hy-emit/src/lib.rs`.
   - When lowering `make([]T, ...)`, check whether element type `T` requires N5 zero initialization (maps, structs with map fields, arrays with map elements, or nested slices with maps). If so, lower via `hy_n5_make(func() T { return <init> }, n[, c])`.
2. **Lower `[N]T` fixed arrays**:
   - Added `TypeExpr::Array` branch to `n5_zero_init_at` in `compiler/crates/hy-emit/src/zeroinit.rs`.
   - Fixed array zero values evaluate via IIFE `func() (hyArr [N]T) { for i := range hyArr { hyArr[i] = <init> }; return hyArr }()`.
3. **Array literal padding**:
   - Padded trailing unkeyed elements in partial array literals `[N]T{...}` with element N5 zero initializers in `compiler/crates/hy-emit/src/expr.rs`.
4. **Corpus & Census**:
   - Added new ACCEPT fixture `tests/checker-corpus/n5-zero-map-allocation-sites.hy` covering all 8 allocation site combinations (A1–A8).
   - Bumped corpus census from 126 to 127 programs (ACCEPT 39 · ACCEPT-MANAGED 2 · REJECT 86) across all 5 census surfaces (`GUARANTEES.md`, `tests/checker-corpus/README.md`, `tests/checker-corpus/VERDICTS.md`, `hy-syntax/src/ast.rs`, `hy-syntax/tests/parse_all.rs`).
5. **Tests**:
   - Added `n5_zero_map_allocation_sites_corpus_program_output` end-to-end byte-exact output test in `compiler/crates/hyb/tests/spec_n5_zero_maps.rs`.
   - Added 3 emission shape tests in `compiler/crates/hy-emit/tests/n5_zero_map_lowering.rs`.
   - All tests pass (100% pass rate).

Closes #1206.

Payout Address: `0xC345C07229307d4f1c7935aD2cAe48e390215808` (Base / Polygon / Arbitrum USDC)
